warnings.headline: Rain Yellow Warning for Bosnia and Herzegovina - region Bihac
warnings.instruction: Be aware of the possibility of local flooding of a small number of properties, with local disruption to outdoor activities. Difficult driving conditions due to reduced visibility and uncontrolled movement of vehicles due to water.
warnings.sender: Hydrometeorological Institute of Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina

warnings.headline: Moderate Wind Warning (Degree 2/4) - Slovenia / South-East
warnings.description: Maximum wind speed : from 50 to 70 km/h. Wind sways trees and may break smaller branches.
warnings.instruction: Doors and windows should be kept closed. We recommend additional caution in traffic, especially in crosswinds and in exposed areas (e.g. bridges, cuttings). Do not linger in potentially dangerous areas.
